subject: general
question: On the tag price, a seller offers a 10% discount and a cashback of ₹250. He still earns 10% profit. If the cost price is ₹1,200, then the tag price (rounded off to 2 decimal places) is ₹______.
solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = ₹1,200

Discount = 10%

Cashback = ₹250

Profit = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = CP + Profit

Discounted Price (DP) = Tag Price × (1 - Discount)

SP = DP - Cashback

**Calculation:**

Profit = 10% of CP

Profit = 0.10 × 1200 = ₹120

SP = CP + Profit

SP = 1200 + 120 = ₹1320

Let Tag Price be T

DP = T × (1 - 0.10)

DP = T × 0.90

SP = DP - Cashback

1320 = T × 0.90 - 250

⇒ 1320 + 250 = T × 0.90

⇒ 1570 = T × 0.90

⇒ T = 1570 / 0.90

⇒ T = 1744.44

**The tag price (rounded off to 2 decimal places) is ₹1744.44.**
